changes.title: Map in worker
items: Sailing to an island lands sooner: the island is made while the chart flies you there

changes.title: Hazel tall
items: The hazel forest no longer has mushroom-shaped trees: a tall hazel, grown up from a coppice in a few slim stems, takes their place

changes.title: Sail hygiene
items: A party animal asleep, or in its party clothes, is always drawn as its own kind (one could show another island's animal)

changes.title: Chart meshes
items: The sea chart opens much sooner after you press E at the map table
On the sea chart, home and the islands you can sail to rise first, then the rest in phase order, one at a time and smoothly
